summary: One official-source Surrey arts event qualified. All other candidates were rejected, held, or treated as already covered because they lacked a fresh distinct reader decision, repeated prior queues, required owner approval, had stale source dates, or were already published.

examples: Community Picnic at Adams Road Park
Coquitlam Protecting Key Wildlife Corridor along Partington Creek
Road Work - Como Lake Avenue between Clarke Road and North Road
Surrey Youth Stewardship Squad
Sounds of Summer: The Boot Scooters & Line Dancing
Burnaby Blues + Roots Festival
Big Things Are Happening: Four Major Projects Shaping Surrey's Future

rejectionGroups.reason: stale source date or retrospective item
examples: Emerging O-Line Giving The Lions An Extra Push
Lions Announce Details For 2nd Annual Orange Shirt Day Game
Summer Discovery Days: Colours of the Fraser
Downtown Front Yard: Royal City Concert Band
City Hall Illumination - Green - Canadian Injury Prevention Day
Fired Up for Football Watch Party - Canada vs Morocco

rejectionGroups.reason: thin or repetitive calendar listing without a stronger standalone reader decision this sweep
examples: Park Play at Robertson Drive Park
Cinema Under the Stars
Music in the Square
Summer in the City
Village Cafe Series Events
Intro to Hand Embroidery Workshop
Downtown's Front Yard: Lawn Games at the Pier

rejectionGroups.reason: one-sided, sensitive, or owner-review civic/legal/audit topic
examples: Mayor's statement on Metro Vancouver governance reform
BC Supreme Court Decision - Impact on Property Titles
Richmond Olympic Oval Corporation - Performance & Forensic Audits
Regular Council Meeting Agenda - July 27, 2026

rejectionGroups.reason: sports/team-media item lacked immediate Lower Mainland planning utility or source independence
examples: Kevin Lankinen and Linus Karlsson Join Canucks Insider Podcast
Whitecaps FC gain hard-earned point on the road before returning to BC Place
Jim Evenson Earns Posthumous Induction To Canadian Football Hall Of Fame
Post-Practice July 27 | Justin McInnis
